To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the LabVIEW platform provides a good experimental validation platform of the fractional order control.
the fractional order controllers designed under systematic design specifications have been successfully realized on the LabVIEW platform.
the fractional order controllers have better control performance than integer order controllers under the same design criteria.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the realization and experimental validation of the FO controllers on the LabVIEW platform which is the most popular software in the control domain.
the experimental study of fractional order motion control and its future applications.
the realization of fractional order controllers and the cooperative control of multiple robots.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the FO controllers have been successfully implemented on LabVIEW hardware in loop platform, the experimental results have been obtained to show the advantages of the fractional order controllers over the traditional PID controller, the future work is to implement the cooperative motion control with multi LabVIEW hardware in loops.
the fractional order controllers can be easily realized on the LabVIEW platform, and the experimental validation of the FO controllers is feasible.
the LabVIEW platform is a powerful and convenient tool for fractional order control system design, implementation and experimental validation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can implement fractional order motion controllers in the LabVIEW hardware-in-the-loop platform.

the fractional order controllers have been successfully implemented and tested in the LabVIEW based real time experiments, which is an important step for the fractional calculus to be widely used in the motion control domain.
we have made the fractional order control more popular by providing a simple and effective experimental validation of the fractional order control.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the fractional calculus is an effective method for improving the performance of the traditional integer order controllers and the LabVIEW platform can be used to validate the effectiveness of the fractional order controllers in a convenient way.
the FO controllers are more suitable for the motion control applications with the high order dynamics and time delay.
LabVIEW is a good tool to implement the fractional order control in real time experiments.
